contea di ritrovamento: Central Bedfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy nummusfrom the reign ofConstantine I (AD 306-337), dating AD 330-1. Reece period 17. Coin commemorating the founding of Constantinopolis, winged Victory standing left on prow of ship on the reverse. Minted in Trier.Likely to beRIC VII Trier 543, though due to wear parts of the inscription and exregue are no longer clearly legible. Dimensions: diameter: 17.24 mm; weight: 1.70g
